# teams_audio_file (Resource)

Uploads a recording for auto attendant menus and call queues. Teams deletes a file that no menu or queue uses within about 48 hours of upload, so link it in the same apply. The file content is not stored in state. Any change requires replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_audio_file" "greeting" {
  usage  = "auto_attendant"
  source = "${path.module}/audio/greeting.wav"
}

resource "teams_audio_file" "hold_music" {
  usage     = "call_queue"
  source    = "${path.module}/audio/hold-music.mp3"
  file_name = "support-hold-music.mp3"
}

# Link each file in the same apply; Teams deletes unused files within about 48 hours.
resource "teams_auto_attendant" "main" {
  name         = "Main line"
  time_zone_id = "Central Standard Time"

  default_call_flow {
    greeting_audio_file_id = teams_audio_file.greeting.id
    menu_prompt            = "For support, press 1."
    menu_option = [
      { key = "1", action = "transfer", target_id = "tel:+18005550100", target_type = "external_pstn" },
    ]
  }
}

resource "teams_call_queue" "support" {
  name                        = "Support"
  music_on_hold_audio_file_id = teams_audio_file.hold_music.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) Path of the local file to upload, read at plan and apply time. WAV, WMA or MP3, at most 5 MB. After an import this is unset, so setting it replaces the file.
- `usage` (String) Where the file is used: auto_attendant, call_queue or tenant_global.

### Optional

- `file_name` (String) File name stored in Teams, ending in .wav, .mp3 or .wma. Defaults to the base name of source.

### Read-Only

- `duration` (String) Length of the recording, e.g. 00:00:03.
- `id` (String) Audio file id.
- `scheduled_for_deletion` (Boolean) True while no auto attendant or call queue uses the file and Teams plans to delete it.
- `source_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the uploaded file. A changed file is uploaded again.
